text:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — we need a compact GA playbook for embedded SDK customers. Core asks: clear SLA tiers for SDK-hosted vs customer-hosted, a docs checklist for onboarding (integrations, client metrics), support routing for contract customers, and monitoring/alerting hooks. I sketched a proposed minimal set below. Thoughts?

Ajay (Eng): SG. For SLAs do we want p50/p95 latency or just availability + error rate? Embedded users care about tail latency.

Maria (PM): Good q — propose availability (99.9 for paid tier), error rate <0.1% and tail token latency budgets: p95 < 200ms for short requests, p99 < 500ms for bursty flows. These are gated for "Hosted SDK" only; customer-hosted gets guidance but no SLA.

Liz (Docs): I'll draft an "Embedded SDK GA" doc with sections: quickstart, contract checklist, required instrumentation, troubleshooting, rollback guidance. Need exact config names and sample snippet from the SDK.

Ajay (Eng): Snippet for the SDK config we can publish (proposal):

```json
{
  "deployment": "hosted",
  "sla_tier": "standard",
  "telemetry": {
    "client_heartbeat": 60,
    "flush_interval_ms": 2000
  },
  "fallback_policy": "region_fallback"
}
```

Ajay (Eng): The important bits are `client_heartbeat` + `flush_interval_ms` so our prefix caching and KV reuse stay warm.

David (SRE): For monitoring we need: customer-visible health (normalized 5xx rate), SDK-side telemetry (queue depth, flush latency), and per-customer synthetic canary that exercises inference paths. Alerts: escalations to oncall when 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m, or p99 token latency > 1s for 10m.

Maria (PM): Ownership proposals: Docs — Liz; SLA paper + commercial wording — me + legal; Instrumentation specs + telemetry contract — Ajay + David; Support routing + entitlement checks — ops team (cc @ops-bot). Can we commit to drafts by EOD Friday?

Liz (Docs): I can do a first draft by Thursday EOD. Will add an "integration test checklist" for SDK partners.

Ajay (Eng): I'll write the telemetry contract and add hooks into the SDK by Friday, will include fallback examples and local offline mode.

David (SRE): I'll make a Prometheus alert group and a short runbook for ops. Need a list of customers to add synthetic checks for — Maria, can you share initial list?

Maria (PM): Yep — will DM the list and update the internal planning doc: https://redwood.internal/ga/embedded-sdk-playbook (proto). Please add comments there.

ops-bot: Checklist created: "embedded-sdk-ga-playbook" assigned to Liz, Ajay, David, Maria. Due: 2025-07-11. Status: todo. :white_check_mark:

Ajay (Eng): One more: pricing/prorating for SDK customers who hit heavy token volume while on a standard SLA — do we want automatic throttles or billing-only? I'd prefer throttles with billing warnings.

Maria (PM): Recommend soft throttles + billing alerts for first 90 days, then revisit. Add to pricing appendix.

Liz (Docs): Noted, adding a sample email template and escalation matrix.

Maria (PM): Great — thanks all. If nobody objects I'll mark this as the GA scope baseline and start the contractual wording draft. :thumbsup:

Ajay (Eng): LGTM.

David (SRE): LGTM, will sync on runbook once alerts are live.
